issues: The five gate modals (Select Language → Cookies → Terms & Conditions → Meet Lex onboarding → Try Lex) all stack on signin route, blocking automated Playwright signin. Pre-setting localStorage keys doesn't help because the React state ignores them on cold mount in preview. Manual users can dismiss them, but every automated test agent will hit this. Consider gating Try Lex modal so it doesn't show when a sign-in form is already on screen.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend signing + jurisdiction cap + auth/preferences fixes are all confirmed working. For the frontend signature draw + PDF download flow: the test script in this iteration was correct but is blocked by 5 stacked modals on /signin (Language → Cookies → T&C → Meet Lex → Try Lex). Two options to unblock: (a) main agent adds an env flag to disable the Try Lex modal when on /signin, (b) testing agent runs the flow in a fresh browser context where it manually clicks through ALL 5 modals (the order is: Cookies 'Accept all' → Language 'OK' → T&C agree+continue → Meet Lex 'Skip' → Try Lex X-close). Once past the stack, the signin form is reachable at the same /signin URL, and the tile-letter → letter-lib-modal → template → form fill → letter-gen-btn → wait for letter-output → toggle-signature-btn → draw on signature-canvas → letter-pdf flow should work as the code review confirms all wiring is correct.
rca_of_the_issue: Not an issue — all 4 main-agent fixes verified. Frontend automation blocker is environmental: the preview env's /signin route shows a stack of intro/gate modals that re-render on every cold mount, making automated signin fragile. Recommend either suppressing the Try Lex CTA on the /signin route, or adding a `?automation=1` URL param to skip all gating modals for E2E tests.
